description: CIA World Factbook country profile (final 2026 edition): background history, geography, population and demographics, ethnic groups, languages, religions, government type, capital, constitution, legal system, executive and legislative branches, economy (GDP, growth, inflation, exports, imports, debt), energy, military, transnational issues. Use for "tell me about Kenya", "what type of government does Chile have", "Factbook profile of Vietnam". Accepts a country or territory name, an ISO code, or "gec:<code>". Returns the five core sections by default; pass sections to choose others or "all".

country.description: Country or territory name ("Kenya", "South Korea", "Greenland"), ISO 3166 code ("KE", "KOR"), or a Factbook code as "gec:ke".

sections.description: Sections to return. Default: Introduction, Geography, People and Society, Government, Economy. Others: Environment, Energy, Communications, Transportation, Military and Security, Space, Terrorism, Transnational Issues. ["all"] returns every section (~35 KB).

name: factbook_country
title: Factbook Country
